items.question: What AI consulting services do you offer for startups?
items.answer: We offer four core services: AI Automations (workflow automation and chatbots), AI Marketing Studio (content and campaign automation), AI-Powered Web Development (modern web platforms and apps), and AI Consultancy & Digital Transformation (strategic AI guidance and roadmaps). All services are priced between $3,000–$10,000 USD.

items.question: How much do AI automation solutions cost?
items.answer: Our AI solutions range from $3,000 to $10,000 USD depending on complexity. This includes custom AI-powered workflow automations, chatbot development, document processing, and integration with your existing business tools.

items.question: Do you serve clients in Latin America?
items.answer: Yes. We are fully bilingual (English and Spanish) and serve clients across the United States and Latin America. We have offices in Milton, Florida (US) and Quito, Ecuador.

items.question: What does your AI web development process look like?
items.answer: We follow an agile approach: discovery call, requirements gathering, design and architecture, iterative development with AI assistance, testing, and deployment. Most projects are delivered within 4–12 weeks using modern technologies like React, Astro, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

items.question: Can you help my small business with AI integration?
items.answer: Absolutely. We specialize in helping small and medium businesses adopt AI practically. Whether you need to automate repetitive tasks, improve marketing with AI, build a modern web platform, or develop an AI strategy, our services start at $3,000 USD.

items.question: What makes JuaneloJGAC Tech different from other AI agencies?
items.answer: We focus exclusively on startups and SMEs, are fully bilingual (English/Spanish), deliver in 4–12 weeks, and take a practical approach to AI — real business results, not theoretical possibilities. You work directly with senior consultants.
